principle: Settlements exist because population, geography, institutions, resources and transport create a viable reason for them.
rules: Settlement size and services must be compatible with population, technology and environment.
Infrastructure requires capacity and may fail, degrade, expand or be repaired.
A settlement is not just a visual landmark; its population and services exist in World State.
Orbital and surface infrastructure are linked through actual transport/logistics capabilities.
Generated settlement layout/detail may use LOD, but stable districts/services retain identity once materialized.
Settlement existence cannot be triggered by player arrival or immediate service need.
Generated settlement names and stable districts persist after materialization.
